# `del_batch_stack_file`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Delete the stored batch-stack files of one frame type.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / probable (64-bit build; 32-bit build probable) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xe27e0, DelBatchStackFile @0x3a6760 (64-bit build) |

Deletes, from storage, every file in the selected frame type's stored batch list and then empties the list, regardless of individual deletion results. Omitting params selects the light list. There is no per-file selector.

Side effects: Calls the media-delete routine on each path in the selected list (files are deleted, not just list entries), then frees the list. Individual deletion failures are ignored. No camera-open or current-task check, no rollback, no timeout; filesystem calls are synchronous. Every full call also makes the shared diagnostic log writes.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"del_batch_stack_file"`. [READ] |
| `params` | object | no | - | Object only; no positional form. Unknown members are ignored. In the 64-bit build a supplied object must carry frame_type; the 32-bit build accepts an object without it and defaults to light. [READ] |
| `params.frame_type` | string | no | light when params are omitted | Calibration frame type whose stored file list is deleted. Case-insensitive exact match of light, dark, bias or flat. A non-string, or a missing member in a supplied object (64-bit build), gives 105; any other string gives 207 (unknown maps to an out-of-range index). Omitting params entirely selects light. One of: `light`, `dark`, `bias`, `flat`. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 107 | params supplied but not an object (including explicit null) | `expected object param` |
| 105 | 64-bit build: frame_type absent or not a string in a supplied object | `expected string param` |
| 207 | frame_type string is not light, dark, bias or flat | `fail to operate` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

Deletion failures are not reported. No active-batch guard was found in the audited helper.

## Example

Request, dark - Delete the stored dark list files (shape from the evidence; values invented):

```json
{"id":44,"method":"del_batch_stack_file","params":{"frame_type":"dark"}}
```

Request, default-light - Params omitted selects light:

```json
{"id":45,"method":"del_batch_stack_file"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"del_batch_stack_file","result":0,"code":0,"id":44}
```

Reply, bad-frame-type:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"del_batch_stack_file","error":"expected string param","code":105,"id":46}
```
